release_title: v1.4.0-alpha.14 — Adapter Replay Fixture Corpus + Coverage Matrix
release_scope: Planning/control-plane milestone: deterministic adapter contract test bench and no-network invocation replay QA after locked v1.4.0-alpha.12 adapter sandbox, locked v1.4.0-alpha.11 safety cockpit, locked v1.4.0-alpha.10 manual live-execution prototype shell, locked v1.4.0-alpha.9 candidate gate, locked v1.4.0-alpha.8 credential boundary drill, locked v1.4.0-alpha.7 source acquisition control surface, and locked v1.4.0-alpha.6 mock-to-live equivalence. Adds deterministic provider adapter fixtures, request/response envelope diffing, no-network invocation replay, adapter failure UX rehearsal, safe transcript comparison, cross-provider capability matrix, and safe metadata-only replay ledger. It does not enable real provider calls, hidden network calls, live source fetching, real OAuth/token lifecycle, real API keys, token storage, credential persistence, backend behavior expansion, storage expansion, uncontrolled scraping, automatic source verification, automatic signoff, automatic export lock, cryptographic signing, or publication permission claims. Locked baselines explicitly include v1.4.0-alpha.12 — Manual Provider Adapter Sandbox + Ephemeral Invocation Contract, v1.4.0-alpha.7 — Source Acquisition Control Surface, v1.4.0-alpha.6 — Provider Execution Harness Mock-to-Live Equivalence, and v1.3.0 — Stable Manual Workflow Release.
